Hi, I'm Pierpaolo

Twenty-eight, with a suitcase full of memories and a rolling pin.

I was born in Lecce, where Sunday lunch never really ends and the smell of simmering sauce is the first way of saying "I love you". Today I live in Lisbon, between the Atlantic and a kitchen that is always on. I cook Italian and Puglian tradition the way I learned it, and I reinvent it with everything the world teaches me.

What I'm after is simple: that at the end of the night your table is still full of voices, and the plates are empty.

Tailor-made experiences

One table, three ways to live it.

There are no photocopied menus. Every experience begins with a chat: you tell me about your evening, I turn it into something you'll remember.

01 Private dinner at home

Puglia Meets Lisbon

Authentic Salento, in your own kitchen.

Close your eyes: the scent of a slow soffritto, warm bread, new olive oil, the sea in the background. With Puglia Meets Lisbon I bring a true Salento evening into your Lisbon home. You set the table, I take care of everything else. A journey of Puglian and Italian courses, cooked on the spot and told plate by plate, with the generosity of a family table.

Your homeMenu made for youRomantic or friends
  • First chat and personalised menu, built around your tastes and allergies
  • Shopping for ingredients and cooking in your kitchen
  • Table service, with the story behind every dish
  • Kitchen left tidy, just as I found it

Perfect for: romantic dinners, anniversaries, evenings with friends, guests to impress.

02 Show cooking & catering for events

The Curious Chef

Italian classics, with an extra stamp in the passport.

Tradition is the starting point, curiosity is the journey. The Curious Chef brings beloved Italian dishes to your event, reimagined with spices, techniques and pairings from around the world. I cook in front of your guests, or prepare and serve for them: either way, the food becomes both show and conversation.

Home, terrace or venueLive or servedParties & events
  • Custom menus for birthdays, parties, corporate gatherings and special occasions
  • Live show cooking or catering service, including buffet and finger food
  • Themed stations: pasta, seafood, starters
  • Extra support on request for larger groups

Perfect for: birthdays, rooftop parties, company events, stag and hen parties, group dinners.

03 Home cooking masterclass

Saper Fare

Learn to make pasta the way they do in Lecce.

Fresh pasta isn't a recipe, it's a gesture. In Saper Fare I teach it to you at home, at your own pace: from dough to shape, from sauce to finished plate. A private lesson for anyone living in Lisbon who wants to take a piece of Italy with them, for expats who miss home, and for locals who are ready to stop draining their pasta too early.

Hands-onYour kitchenSolo, couples, small groups
  • Practical lesson at your home (one-to-one, couples or small groups)
  • Ingredients, tools and recipe cards to keep
  • A menu to learn, then eat together
  • Tricks and secrets of the tradition, explained without rush

Perfect for: couples, friends, original gifts, team building, anyone who wants to really learn.

The Chef

From the land of Salento to the sea of Lisbon.

The roots

I was born and raised in Lecce, in Salento, where the evening light turns the baroque stone pink and the sea is always around the corner. That's where I learned that cooking isn't a job, it's a language. Orecchiette, ragù, vegetables from the garden, good olive oil: every recipe tells of a family, a season, a way of being together.

The journey

Curiosity took me far from my home stove. I discovered that every culture has its own way of saying "welcome" through food, and that the most distant flavours can talk to the ones I know best.

Lisbon

Then came Lisbon. A luminous city facing the ocean like my homeland, with a market around every corner and a soul open to the world. Here I found the right place to join my two halves: the Italian tradition that formed me, and the curiosity that never lets me stand still. Today I cook for those who live, work or have moved here and miss a dish from home, or want to discover a new one.

Good questions.

Do you cook in my home?

Yes. I bring ingredients, equipment and ideas: all you need is a kitchen and a table.

Can I choose the menu?

Of course. We start from a proposal, then shape it together around your tastes, the season and any intolerances.

How do you handle allergies and diets?

Gluten-free, lactose-free, vegetarian, vegan: tell me in advance and we'll build a menu that is safe and delicious.

Where do you work?

Lisbon and surroundings. If you're a bit further out, write to me and we'll see.

How far in advance should I book?

The sooner you write, the better, especially for weekends and holidays. If you're in a hurry, contact me anyway and we'll see what's possible.

How does payment work?

I'll send you a clear, personalised quote. Timing and payment details are agreed together before confirming.
